name: AM 1054-325 (Hubble)
blurb: AM 1054-325, an interacting galaxy with a tidal tail, seen by Hubble.
label: am1054325-hubble
story: A neighbor's gravity has bent this once-flat spiral into an S shape and drawn out a long tidal tail. Newborn star clusters line the tail like a string of pearls.

claims.text: AM 1054-325 is an interacting galaxy whose neighbor bent its spiral shape into an S-curve
Newborn star clusters line its stretched-out tidal tail like a string of pearls
AM 1054-325 is part of a merging system with ESO 376-28 studied for star clusters in tidal tails
Hubble program 14937 observed AM 1054-325 to study star formation in HI-rich tidal tails
